# `FluxRegistrar::register_tool`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Registers one tool descriptor owned by this plugin.

## Signature

```rust
fn register_tool (& mut self , descriptor : & FluxToolDescriptor) -> Result < () , FluxStatus >
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `descriptor` | & [`FluxToolDescriptor`](../structures/fluxtooldescriptor.md) | `descriptor` argument passed as `& FluxToolDescriptor`. |

## Return Value

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxregistrar-register-tool.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxregistrar-register-tool.md)_

```rust
fn register_tool(registrar: &mut FluxRegistrar) -> FluxStatus {
    let descriptor = FluxToolDescriptor {
        id: FluxUtf8Slice::from_str("flux.demo.tool.paint"),
        label: FluxUtf8Slice::from_str("Demo Paint"),
        icon_path: FluxUtf8Slice::from_str("assets/paint.png"),
        silhouette_path: FluxUtf8Slice::from_str("assets/paint_silhouette.png"),
    };
    match registrar.register_tool(&descriptor) {
        Ok(()) => FluxStatus::OK,
        Err(status) => status,
    }
}
```
